needsFromHuman: Acceptance as a RoomPriceGenie Open API partner. Nothing here can be signed up for online.

From RoomPriceGenie, for the development environment: the API base URL, the Partner API Key (and partner ID), and a sandbox property with its client_id and client_secret; stored with: creds set roompricegenie ...
The connector configuration appmixer:roompricegenie (baseUrl, partnerApiKey) on the test instance

For the triggers: the endpoint URL <API URL>/plugins/appmixer/roompricegenie/events registered by RoomPriceGenie, mapped rooms in the sandbox account, and somebody who clicks Upload Prices there while a flow runs
notes: The Partner API Key and the base URL are connector configuration, not account fields: they belong to the partner, and the plugin route needs them without an account to read RoomPriceGenie's signing keys. A connection is one property: property code, client ID, client secret.
The base URL is accepted only as an HTTPS host under roompricegenie.com; Make API Call is pinned to it.

Updates arrive on one plugin route. A request must carry the Partner API Key and an RS256 token signed with a key of the configured host; an update reaches a trigger only when the token's client_id equals the Client ID of the trigger's connection and its audience contains the property code.

Not built: the iframe URL request, the Revenue Intelligence SDK one-time token and the reservation endpoint for 'Standard Partners' (HMAC or key-only schemes for UI embedding and non-Open-API partners).
Not built: any read component. The API has none.
No npm dependency: the token is verified with node:crypto.
verify.json is empty: there is nothing to read and no select input the service echoes.
